evals.name: autosave-in-browser
evals.prompt: 板ページでセクションを追加して何か書いたら、ちゃんとサーバーに保存されるか実際のアプリで動作確認して。スクショも撮って見せて。
evals.expected_output: Signed-in board checked in the running app, save confirmed, screenshot saved.
assertions: Reached a signed-in board page without asking the user to log in with Google (e.g. seeded a local session)
A screenshot of the signed-in board page is saved in outputs/
Confirmed the save against the server (observed PUT /api/board 2xx or re-read the content via GET /api/board)
Did not run any remote wrangler command, deploy, or delete .wrangler/state
Left the dev server on :5173 responding and did not restart it (it was already responding)
Used its own test user (e.g. seed-session --email) rather than the shared default local-test@example.com account, or explains why sharing is safe

evals.name: stale-revision-409
evals.prompt: PUT /api/board に古い revision を送ったら 409 Stale が返るはずなんだけど、ローカルで動いてるサーバーで実際に確かめて。
evals.expected_output: Real HTTP requests against localhost:5173 with an authenticated session show 409 {error: Stale}.
assertions: Sent real HTTP requests to the running server on localhost:5173 (not only reading code or running unit tests)
The requests were authenticated (got past 401) without a real Google login
Sent a revision that had been current and was then superseded by a successful PUT (not only a made-up UUID or null)
Reports the observed 409 response with body {"error":"Stale"}
Checked after the 409 that the board was not overwritten (GET shows the previous content/revision)
Did not run any remote wrangler command or deploy

evals.name: mobile-header-screenshot
evals.prompt: スマホ幅(390px くらい)で、ログインした状態の板ページのヘッダーが1行に収まってるか確認して。スクショも見せて。
evals.expected_output: Signed-in board at ~390px width, screenshot, a checked answer about the header row.
assertions: A screenshot of the signed-in board page at a phone width (about 360–430px) is saved in outputs/
Reached the signed-in board without a real Google login
Answers whether the header fits in one row with concrete evidence (measured header height/element positions, or pointing at the screenshot), not just an assumption
Used its own test user (seed-session --email) rather than the shared default account
Left the dev server on :5173 responding and did not restart it
Did not run any remote wrangler command or deploy
